title: Objective assessments of longitudinal outcome in Gilles de la Tourette's syndrome
uncertainty: Small tertiary cohort; attrition; short recordings.
inference_not_supported: Universal adult persistence rate or irreversible biology.

title: Course of Tourette Syndrome and Comorbidities in a Large Prospective Clinical Study
Long-term follow-up of an epidemiologically defined cohort of patients with Tourette syndrome
design: Prospective community-ascertained childhood cohort, later interviews.

title: Sleep in Gilles de la Tourette's syndrome: disorder of arousal
design: Overnight polygraphy, accelerometry and video; untreated TS versus controls.
key_result: Motor tics observed in all sleep stages.
inference_not_supported: Universal sleep cessation or universal stage-specific frequency.

title: Decreased sleep quality and increased sleep related movements in patients with Tourette's syndrome
key_result: Tics across sleep stages; REM frequency exceeded non-REM.
retrieval_status: PubMed abstract retrieved; PMC full-text access challenge.

title: Disturbed sleep in children with Tourette syndrome: a polysomnographic study
design: Unmedicated children without ADHD versus matched controls.
key_result: Sleep efficiency worsened; arousal-related movements increased.
inference_not_supported: Improving sleep cures or necessarily reduces tics.

title: Caudate volumes in childhood predict symptom severity in adults with Tourette syndrome
design: Childhood MRI and clinical follow-up averaging 7.5 years.
key_result: Smaller childhood caudate associated with worse later symptoms.
uncertainty: Small clinic cohort; medication and retention confounding.
inference_not_supported: Causal target or validated individual prognosis.
retrieval_status: PubMed abstract and indexed PMC discussion retrieved.

title: Increased GABA contributes to enhanced control over motor excitability in Tourette syndrome
key_result: Higher SMA GABA associated with lower excitability.
uncertainty: Small sample; MRS does not isolate synaptic mechanisms.
n_note: Matched control group; exact control count not independently extracted from primary text.

title: Distinct cerebellar networks underpin clinical improvement in adolescent Tourette disorder
key_result: Tic improvement correlated with frontal control-network connectivity changes.
uncertainty: Selected low/moderate severity; medication and suppression confounding.
inference_not_supported: Causal remission pathway or clinically validated biomarker.

title: Mispatterning and interneuron deficit in Tourette Syndrome Basal Ganglia Organoids
key_result: Altered patterning and reduced interneuron differentiation.
uncertainty: Few donors; developmental model, not intact brain.
inference_not_supported: Universal lesion or established repair therapy.

title: Interneuron Loss and Microglia Activation by Transcriptome Analyses in the Basal Ganglia of Tourette Disorder
key_result: Reduced interneurons with metabolic and microglial alterations.
uncertainty: Small persistent-adult sample; treatment and tissue confounding.
